description: Runes lock onto the crystal (f0-1, gold lock ring on f1), then the crystal blooms into 6 facet petals (f2-4) and settles bound (f5 hold). Chime cues f1 + f4. No click, no stars.
status: DRAFT - not approved by Gary, NOT wired into game code
background: fully transparent (1-bit alpha), palette-only opaque pixels
loop: play ONCE in game (hold the last frame)
sheet_layout: horizontal strip, frame i at x=i*frame_w

anchor.usage: draw the frame at (hold_x - anchor.x*k, hold_y - anchor.y*k), k = display px per 2x px; hold = the trainer raised-hands point for the current pose frame

emissive: all (all = draw with the ToD lit grade)

hand_anchor.sprite_px: TBD by Character models: the raised-hands point in each player back-sprite raise frame (x, y in sprite px)

foe_anchor.rule: foe sprite visual centre; rune ring radii 34 x 30 px around it
